newsitem.title: FINLAND: PSP CEO SURPRISED BY OKO MERGER VIEW-MEDIA.
newsitem.headline: PSP CEO SURPRISED BY OKO MERGER VIEW-MEDIA.

text.p: Finnish state-owned commercial bank Postipankki Oy's CEO Eino Keinanen said on Monday he was surprised that the cooperative banking group OKOBANK might be interested in a merger between the two.
Keinanen said on television that he had been "surprised" to hear of OKOBANK CEO Antti Tanskanen's view that OKO might be ready to consider buying Postipankki if it came up for sale.
Tanskanen was interviewed in a regional daily newspaper.
Keinanen said the current structure with three quite large domestic banking groups was appropriate.
